label: CA-PIPEDA-2000 Section 12

obligations.text: Examination of complaint by Commissioner 12 (1) The Commissioner shall conduct an investigation in respect of a complaint, unless the Commissioner is of the opinion that (a) the complainant ought first to exhaust grievance or review procedures otherwise reasonably available;
Notification (3) The Commissioner shall notify the complainant and the organization that the Commissioner will not investigate the complaint or any act alleged in the complaint and give reasons.
